title: Gray Poplar: Great Gray Poplars You Can Visit
meta_description: A natural cross of white poplar and aspen. Ferrara's, 4.44 metres round, screened a courtyard of the Palazzo dei Diamanti for over a century.
intro: Gray poplar is a natural cross between white poplar and aspen, and it grows fast enough that a thick trunk is no proof of great age the way it would be on an oak. Ferrara's, over 150 years old and 4.44 metres round, grew for most of that time screening a private courtyard at the Palazzo dei Diamanti, one of the Italian Renaissance's most recognisable buildings, until a 2023 restoration opened the garden to visitors. Sofia's is the oldest tree in the Doctors' Garden, planted in 1892, four years before the garden formally opened as one of the city's first botanical collections. Warsaw's, on a pavement corner in Mokotow, holds an entry in Poland's national register at 21 metres tall. In Hoorn, storms have torn into one's crown and inspectors still rate it in good condition.
